audience: product teams that collect feature requests and feedback in Featurebase

useCases.title: Find existing requests before a new post
useCases.text: Search post titles and content for a topic. Open a matching post to read its status, board, tags and vote count.

useCases.title: Review posts by board and status
useCases.text: List the boards and post statuses of the workspace. Filter the posts of one board by status, such as planned or shipped.

useCases.title: Search comments for a topic
useCases.text: Search comment text across the workspace for a topic. Open one comment by its id to read it in full.

useCases.title: Create a feedback post on a board
useCases.text: List the boards to find the right one. Create a post on it. A retry can create a duplicate post, so search first.

useCases.title: Reply to a post with a comment
useCases.text: Open the post first. Add a comment, optionally as a reply. A retry can add a duplicate comment.
